scope: One final dedicated naval function glyph. All 36 main equipment choices and four functions are already covered by approved artwork; this proposal must not be installed before approval.
palette_basis: Blue native marine_capacity family: boarding crew/marine function, not an upgrade tier or capital ship profile.
prompts:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: ONE small naval designer FUNCTION MODIFICATION UI icon for Victoria 3.
Input images: Image 1 STYLE AND PALETTE reference ONLY, use the BLUE marine_capacity family at left. Image 2 STYLE reference ONLY, match its compact painted embossed metal rendering, cool steel-blue monochrome and dark bevel edges. Do not copy its rowboat or oars.
Primary request: an ETRAVE / BOARDING SPUR on a GALLEY. Show only a compact wedge-shaped wooden BOW FRAGMENT viewed three-quarter slightly from above, with a visibly long narrow pointed boarding beak projecting forward from the bow. The projecting beak has a simple reinforced metallic pointed cap; thick squared timber structure supports it continuously, not a detached spear. A small curved gunwale and two or three broad deck planks at the rear make it unmistakably part of a ship. The pointed forward spur is the dominant silhouette; no entire vessel or big sail.
Composition: one compact integrated emblem, beak projecting diagonally outward; entire shape visible with padding, broad simple shapes readable at 32 pixels. Coherent perspective and straight structural timbers. ONE cool steel-BLUE palette on every surface, pale-blue broad highlights, navy-blue recesses. Similar level of simplification to native naval glyphs, not a realistic painting, ship plan or detailed diorama.
Backdrop: genuine transparent alpha including gaps, opaque artwork except edge antialiasing, no shadow outside silhouette, no halo or glow. No text, labels, flags, rope, anchor, crossed weapons, cannon, chain, faces, people, ornament, dragon figurehead, engines or sea scenery. Not an ancient fantasy warship or a multi-pronged trident. A plain pointed ship-mounted boarding spur and small bow fragment.
